title: Production Activities
text:
[Page 74] Production Activities
Production Activities
Summary of Production Activities
Production Activities
n In 2014-2015 average oil production in the country remained 94,493 BOPD and gas production was 4,016 MMCFD
n OGDCL was the highest oil production company with a production of 15.401 million barrels at an average rate of 42,194 BOPD.
n OGDCL's share was 44.7% of the yearly oil production of the country.
n MOL produced 7.304 million barrels.
n UEPL produced 6.498 million barrels.
n PPL produced 2.352 million barrels.
n POL produced 0.621 million barrels.
n BHP produced 0.305 million barrels.
n MPCL produced 0.766 million barrels.
n OPL produced 0.202 million barrels.
n Eni Pakistan produced 0.132 million barrels.
n Dewan Petroleum produced 0.039 million barrels.
n OMV Maurice produced 0.842 million barrels.
n OMV produced 0.026 million barrels.
n OGDCL was also the major producer of Gas in the year.
n OGDCL produced 426.472 BCF of gas, at an average rate of 1,168 MMCFD, this constitute around 29% of the total yearly gas
production of the country.
n PPL was the second highest gas producing company with 232.737 BCF at an average of 638 MMCFD, which is around 15.9% of
the total yearly gas production of the country.

n In 2014-2015 average oil production in the country remained 94,493 BOPD and gas production was 4,016 MMCFD
n OGDCL was the highest oil production company with a production of 15.401 million barrels at an average rate of 42,194 BOPD.
n OGDCL's share was 44.7% of the yearly oil production of the country.
n Hycarbex produced 1.298 BCF.
n POGC produced 3.554 BCF.
n OPL produced 2.734 BCF.
n In the fiscal year 2014-15 the LPG production was 1,250 metric tons per day.
n In refineries PARCO was the major LPG producer with an average of 390 metric tons per day.
n In companies MOL produced 350 metric tons per day.
n The total remaining recoverable oil reserves at the end of the fiscal year 2014-15 have been estimated as 384.41 million US barrels.
n The remaining gas reserves (including non-pipeline quality gas) as 20.26Trillion Cubic Feet.
